apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

result-emitted.eventDescription: One normalized restaurant or menu-item record written to the dataset. Analytics and run summaries are free.

limits: This record verifies billing configuration and source placement; it does not independently authenticate a customer output or prove source availability
Any subsequent publication build and public propagation must be verified separately
notes: Delivered menu items, restaurant fallback rows and menu-change summary rows cost $0.003 each. Postcode matrices, inflation summaries and the run summary have no result event. The active pricing has no `menu-change-digest` event; a successfully stored digest is marked `UNPRICED_FREE`. Startup is $0.005 per GB, minimum one event; default 2 GB adds $0.01. For 400 billable rows, event charges are $1.21 per run. A later failure or abort can retain earlier delivered and charged rows. The current Pricing tab shows platform costs included; the publisher still incurs compute and proxy costs. Row limits and charge limits do not prove complete menus or cap the publisher costs.
publicationScope: Verified cloud release and linked GitHub sample
